svg.title: One compiled model under three array libraries
svg.desc: Panel a: nutrient, producer and grazer concentrations over forty time units from a six-state chemostat integrated by fixed-step Runge-Kutta, with open markers from an adaptive reference solver lying on the curves. Panel b: bar chart of final-state error against that reference for NumPy, JAX and PyTorch in float64 and float32; the three float64 bars are equal to the displayed digits at about one times ten to the minus eight and the three float32 bars at about five times ten to the minus six. Dotted and dash-dot lines mark machine epsilon for float64 and float32 as references.
